applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Select the beneficiary's receiving currency. CNY, offshore CNH and foreign-currency payments have different availability and evidence requirements.

| Item | Portal term |
|---|---|
| Minimum CNY conversion payment | CNY 15 |
| Maximum single CNY conversion payment | CNY 5,000,000 |
| Minimum foreign-currency payment | USD 50 or its equivalent |
| Maximum JPY payment | JPY 900,000,000 |
| Maximum other foreign-currency payment | 90,000,000 units, subject to the transaction page's applicable limit |

Incoming collection has no general maximum in this Portal limit table. A beneficiary bank may have its own daily receipt limit; payments on different dates may be needed for that bank's limit.

CNH cannot be converted directly to THB through the Portal route described here. THB-to-THB is not available through same-name withdrawal: the supported alternatives are a third-party transfer arrangement or conversion to a supported G10 currency before withdrawal, subject to the actual recipient and route requirements. EGP is available where the transaction page offers the currency pair.

## Payment verification

Use the CedarPay payment password. The security setting can allow system-selected additional verification or require password plus SMS for every payment. When the bank-payment flow requires a phone code, email cannot replace it. World Card's separate 3DS flow has its own delivery options.

For a balance below the CNY 15 minimum, account closure, specified card FX-difference repayment or an exceptional service case can be referred for a small-payment exception. An exception request is not approval to bypass the minimum.
